amendment: A16b -- DEVIATION from A16 pre-registration, declared not silent
why: A16 froze the residual control set as [log10(area), petma, relief]. petma (NHDPlus HR EROM mean annual potential evapotranspiration) is served as literal 0 on every reach nationwide (MapServer/3 returnCountOnly where petma IS NOT NULL = 24,264,177, all zero). current_leg.py:_pos() correctly reads 0 as NODATA rather than a measurement, so pet_mean is None on 1,025/1,025 rows in all three arms, residualise() excluded every point, and the PRIMARY declared statistic returned n=0 / "insufficient n". The bars that decide may_reorder_list (i, ii, iii, v) read v_max_fps, not stream power, so the LEG VERDICT is unaffected and stands as computed. What was left untested is the single contrast that came out positive.
deviation: PET dropped from the control set. Controls are the two that exist in the data: log10(area_max_km2), relief_m.

preregistered_3_control.status: UNRUN -- control variable absent at source

verdict: The raw stream-power contrast survivors vs null-fault (p=0.0025) does NOT survive its own confound control: residualised on drainage area and relief, p=0.1211. The advantage was catchment size and terrain, which is the same nuisance variable §4 spent four legs on. A16 moves no name. This is now a TESTED null rather than an untested one.
guard_restated: A16 may not move a name unless bars ii, iii and v all pass. They did not. This amendment does not touch that arithmetic.
